security_spec.violation_condition: When the vector decoder dispatches a Zvdot4a8i instruction (vdot4a, vdot4au, vdot4asu, vdot4aus) with vtype.vsew != 32 (i.e., SEW != 32), the XiangShan RTL executes the instruction instead of raising an illegal instruction exception. The spec mandates these instructions are only defined for SEW=32; all other SEW values are reserved. Executing with wrong SEW causes the 4-element sub-element unpacking logic to slice 32-bit element groups at incorrect bit boundaries, producing wrong multiplicands/multipliers and corrupting the accumulator destination register.
security_spec.summary: Zvdot4a8i instructions are only defined for SEW=32; XiangShan vector decoder must trap on any other SEW value, otherwise sub-element slicing at wrong bit boundaries corrupts accumulator data

findings.finding: Zvdot4a8i instructions (vdot4a, vdot4au, vdot4asu, vdot4aus) are NOT decoded — no entries exist in opivv/opivx/opivi/opmvv/opmvx tables. Any attempt to execute these opcodes hits decodeDefault (DecodeUnit.scala:50-61) which sets selImm=INVALID_INSTR, triggering an illegal instruction exception. Correct behavior for unimplemented reserved opcodes.

No SEW constraint check exists for vdot4a* instructions (expected: SEW must be 32/e32, i.e., SEW===3). While this is benign today because Zvdot4a8i is not decoded, if the extension is added in the future without adding a SEW==32 check (analogous to intExtEewIllegal or wnEewIllegal), the RTL would execute vdot4a* with arbitrary SEW, causing sub-element boundary misalignment and accumulator corruption.
findings.snippet:
// VecExceptionGen.scala:185-200 — existing SEW check infrastructure
// No entry for vdot4a* — would need: SEW =/= 3.U → illegal
private val intExtEewIllegal = intExt2 && SEW === 0.U ||
                                intExt4 && SEW <= 1.U ||
                                intExt8 && SEW <= 2.U
private val wnEewIllegal = (vdWideningInst || narrowingInst || redWideningInst) && SEW === 3.U
private val eewIllegal = fpEewIllegal || intExtEewIllegal || wnEewIllegal

findings.finding: Zvdot4a8i is not in the ISA extension list. The extension configuration only includes Zvbb and Zvkt among vector crypto extensions. Correct: unimplemented extensions should not be advertised.
